title: Core Web Vitals
description: Investigate core web vitals in Next.js 16 with a defective starter, repaired instructor module, executable offline contract and framework example.
objectives: Diagnose the core web vitals failure through a real example
Repair the learner fixture with a precise invariant and explicit edge cases
Verify the result offline and distinguish those checks from framework end-to-end tests

I can explain one positive and one negative case without a hosted service
